originality.rationale: Existing work counts the 240 packings and even 840 four-spread intersections between packing pairs, which are credited. Inspected primary full texts and indexed claim search did not explicitly determine the complete Boolean trace-support complex or the two 3360 projective facet orbits. The latter are the discriminating additional claim; priority risk from unindexed design tables remains.
